describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile walking, with the overall size, shape, fur and head of a brown bear but with beetle-like structures integrated into its body. Its entire body except for the back is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle and on the chest and belly, with a short furry tail at the rear and four thick legs ending in clawed paws. A single long, glossy, dark brown, sickle-shaped horn curves up and back from the middle of its forehead, and its dorsal side from the shoulders to the rump is covered by two large, smooth, domed, glossy dark brown hard shell plates. Along both flanks just below the edges of the shell there are rows of small, dark, oval holes in the fur.
